title: DailyTasksPlus
description: A lightweight Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Tasks plugin with GUI, rewards, MySQL support, and PlaceholderAPI integration.
body:
DailyTasksPlus is a lightweight and customizable daily tasks plugin for Minecraft servers.
It encourages player activity by rewarding them for completing simple daily objectives like breaking blocks, chatting, walking, or killing mobs.

Perfect for survival, SMP, and economy-based servers.

✨ Features

📋 Daily task system

🎯 Different targets per task

🎁 Different rewards per task

💰 Vault economy support

⚡ Fast & lightweight

🧩 Multiple task types

🖥️ Paper / Spigot compatible

🆓 Free version – no paywall

🧩 Available Tasks

⛏️ Break Blocks

💬 Send Chat Messages

🚶 Walk Distance

🗡️ Kill Mobs

(More task types planned!)

🎁 Rewards

Economy rewards via Vault

Fully configurable per task

Rewards are given automatically on task completion

Example:

Complete a task → Get money instantly 💸

⚙️ Commands

/tasks – Open daily tasks menu

🔧 Requirements

Minecraft: 1.21+

Server: Paper / Spigot

Optional: Vault (for economy rewards)

🛣️ Planned Features

📅 Weekly & Monthly tasks

🧩 PlaceholderAPI support

🗄️ MySQL storage

🎨 More GUI customization

🧠 More advanced task types
